rule: Every SynStudios feature should note a Frontier Syntax counterpart.

entries.frontier_target: Sprite sheet import codegen — horizontal/vertical/grid strip layouts
entries.insight: Preset buttons encode frame fps, dimensions, and padding matching Aseprite export; Frontier wasm codegen can emit equivalent strip metadata structs.
entries.frontier_file_hint: src/wasm_codegen/ or AnimationLoader conventions in Godot bridge

entries.frontier_target: scripts/tracking.py gate parity for Play Store / compiler release
entries.insight: Taylor worker orchestration pattern (W1–W8) mirrors Frontier's phase gate model; reuse evidence JSON schema in frontier-syntax manifest/tracking_evidence.json.

entries.synstudios_feature: Benchmark JSON direct Downloads save on Android
entries.insight: MediaStore Downloads write pattern validates on-device telemetry export without share sheet — applicable to Frontier benchmark manifests on Android host.

entries.synstudios_feature: UE 5.8 viewport tuning — lit/unlit/wire, cine camera, sequencer speed, safe area
entries.frontier_target: Trial scene viewport metadata codegen + sequencer timing types
entries.insight: SceneTuning preset patches mirror UE view modes and playback rate; Frontier can serialize equivalent structs for wasm-hosted cinematic trials.

entries.synstudios_feature: Asset import roadmap — proxy preview, streamed glTF, SAF folder link
entries.frontier_target: Trial pack schema + wasm-sidecar for animation metadata without mesh embed
entries.insight: Phase 2–5 roadmap defines JSON-only trial manifests Frontier can compile; keeps host memory flat while users reference real UE/Godot exports.

entries.synstudios_feature: Phase 2 proxy preview — auto strip, trial.json sidecar, GLB header
entries.frontier_target: TrialPack v1 wasm struct + thumbnail codegen
entries.insight: Web Worker builds 8-frame proxy; trial.json carries fps/duration without binary embed; GLB header parse for silhouette bounds

entries.synstudios_feature: Phase 3 streamed glTF trial — budgeted mesh preview
entries.frontier_target: TrialPack glTF stream module + Draco decode hook
entries.insight: 12 MB cap, 8 mesh max, Draco/meshopt >4 MB, 2048 texture downscale; CDN Draco WASM keeps APK lean
